slides.needs: lone boxer in empty gym at night, from behind
slides.text: 4 reasons you'll never get good at boxing...

slides.needs: row of heavy bags in dark gym
slides.text: You only hit the bag. Bags don't hit back. Add defense to every combo.
You skip the basics. Pros still drill the jab every single session.

slides.needs: gym bag and gloves on floor, early morning
slides.text: You train when you feel like it. Three sessions a week beats one perfect week a month.

slides.needs: phone on tripod filming in gym
slides.text: You never watch yourself. Film one round a week and find one mistake.
